title: Work-chain recurrence
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean work-tape symbols, let $w$ be a finite Boolean input, let $t\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\tau$ be a work-tape index, and let $z\in\mathbb{Z}$. The work-chain value at $z$ after $t$ steps equals the contents of cell $z$ on tape $\tau$ if that tape's head is at $z$; otherwise it equals the work-chain value at $z-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
